mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS in the bottom 25% of historical levels yields negative 20d SPX returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% occurs and SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the same month, but SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of such months, or Rank IC for interaction < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased discount rates and reduced risk appetite from policy rate hikes.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rising occurs and SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS (rising) < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced corporate production capacity and earnings uncertainty.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 104.0 occurs and SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) signals stagflationary risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer purchasing power and central bank policy uncertainty.
failure_condition: HOUST MoM decline and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% occur, but SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of months, or Rank IC for interaction < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 475,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through higher corporate revenue visibility and earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 475000 occurs and SPX 60d returns are negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 over two consecutive months signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate output and supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 104.0 for two consecutive months and SPX 60d returns are positive in >60% of periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
